meta.title: Attend a Meeting
meta.description: Tell us you're coming to a Wednesday-evening meeting in Metrotown, Burnaby BC. Guests visit for free.

page_hero.headline: Tell us you're coming
page_hero.intro: Wednesdays, 6:00 – 8:00 pm at Metropolis at Metrotown. Guests are always free.

headline: Tell us you're coming
lead: Guests sit in, watch, and leave whenever they like — no speaking required on your first visit. Let us know you're planning to come and someone will meet you at the door.
finding_the_room:
Winners Community Room, Metropolis at Metrotown, Burnaby.
Enter through the two double doors beside Winners.

expect.heading: What to expect on your first visit

items.body: The Toastmaster of the evening will greet you at the door and show you to a seat.
Two hours of prepared speeches, impromptu Table Topics, and structured evaluations. Guests are welcome to try Table Topics, but nobody is called on without asking first.

items.step: Stay for a few minutes after
items.body: This is when the real introductions happen. Everyone is friendly — most members were guests once.
